map.大矩阵手工算容易错怎么办？: What if manual calculation of a large matrix is error-prone?
map.手算高阶行列式确实容易出错，通常用「初等行变换化成上三角、再取对角线乘积」的办法: Computing high-order determinants by hand is indeed error-prone; the usual approach is "elementary row operations to upper triangular form, then take the product of the diagonal", much easier than expansion by minors. Remember that swapping two rows flips the sign, and multiplying a row by k multiplies the determinant by k as well. In engineering hand it off to a numerical library, but note that determinants near zero may just be floating-point error.
